steps.message:
Recovered. Your "Move to Stanford" commit (650dba4) had been left on a detached HEAD after the `git checkout master`. The reflog pointed straight to it (`git reflog` showed it as `HEAD@{1}`).

What I did:
1. `git merge --no-ff 650dba4` to bring it back on master as a real merge commit.
2. Resolved a conflict in `_includes/about.md` by keeping the Stanford bio line (the "sixth PhD candidate at UW" line on the master side was the old text you were replacing).
3. Committed the merge — master is now at 803adbe with both histories preserved.

Heads-up: it looks like a `git reset` to d7d3e4b happened shortly before, so any commits between d7d3e4b and 650dba4 that weren't yours would also be gone for good. Worth double-checking with `git log --all` that nothing else is missing.
